description: This file defines the LeaveParameterObject class in the OrangeHRM system, which encapsulates leave request parameters including employee ID, leave type, date range, comments, and leave durations for single or multi-day leaves. It provides validation and management of leave data for HR processes.

classes.name: LeaveParameterObject
classes.description: Represents parameters for a leave request, supporting both single and multi-day leaves, with methods for setting and retrieving leave details along with validation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a leave parameter object with employee number, leave type ID, start date, and end date, performing necessary validation.

methods.name: isMultiDayLeave
methods.description: Returns true if the leave spans multiple days.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's unique identifier.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee's unique identifier.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Retrieves the ID representing the type of leave.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the type of leave.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the leave.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the leave.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave with validation that it is after the start date.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves an optional comment associated with the leave.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets an optional comment for the leave.

methods.name: getSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the duration details if leave is single-day; throws if called on multi-day leave.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the leave duration for a single-day leave.

methods.name: getStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the start portion duration for a multi-day leave, validating partial options.

methods.name: setStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the start portion duration for a multi-day leave with validation.

methods.name: getEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the end portion duration for a multi-day leave, validating partial options.

methods.name: setEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the end portion duration for a multi-day leave with validation.

methods.name: getMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Retrieves the partial leave option for multi-day leaves, validating that leave is multi-day.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Sets the partial leave option for multi-day leaves, validating allowed values.

methods.name: checkDurationTypeForMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Private validation method to ensure the leave duration type is compatible with multi-day leaves.

methods.name: checkMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Private validation method to verify the current partial option is permitted for the leave duration.
